issue.title: [Bug] a2p recursive schema failure
issue.body:
### What were you trying to do?

Convert an Avro schema with a self-referencing record to Protocol Buffers.

### What happened?

The command stopped with `RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded` instead of writing a .proto file.

### Small example or steps (optional)

```shell
avrotize a2p input.avsc output.proto --naming camel
```

```json
{"type":"record","name":"Node","fields":[{"name":"children","type":{"type":"array","items":"Node"}}]}
```

### Where did this happen? (optional)

Avrotize CLI

### Command or Avrotize area (optional)

avrotize a2p

### Version and environment (optional)

Avrotize 3.9.0, Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.12.3, protoc 25.1

### Anything else? (optional)

This worked with Avrotize 3.8.2.
